answer_1.quote: In particular, the strong document summarization capabilities of LLMs have accelerated the development of LLM-based news summarization systems ... we adopt a minimal-prompting strategy ... to generate summaries.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the impact of media outlet attribution on summaries, we ... extract named entities using a named entity recognition (NER) model and analyze their sentiment to track changes in the proportion of positive, negative, and neutral expressions.

answer_4.quote: We recruit five annotators from English-speaking countries ... Annotators classify the perceived political stance (left, center, or right) of summaries generated from identical source articles but prompted with left-, center-, or right-leaning media outlet names.
answer_4.guideline: Political Bias Classification Instructions. ... select the political bias that best fits based on its language, tone, framing ... Left, Center, Right ... If uncertain, choose the category that the overall tone and language lean toward the most.
